projections.title: Soveraeign Disposition Profile
projections.intended_use: Readable projection of the native experimental constructs without remapping them to another personality framework.

projections.title: Big Five-like Research Projection
projections.intended_use: Hypothesis-generation only; not an official Big Five score or validated crosswalk.
loss: No experimental mapping is asserted for agreeableness or negative emotionality/neuroticism.
These operational constructs are not assumed measurement-equivalent to human Big Five traits.
Weights are hypotheses for testing, not calibrated coefficients.

projections.title: MBTI-like Research Projection
projections.intended_use: Communication experiment only; not an MBTI result.
loss: No Thinking/Feeling-like axis is projected in v0.1.
Continuous operational evidence is compressed into framework-like axes only on explicit request.
No categorical type is emitted by the deterministic tool.

projections.title: CVI-like Research Projection
projections.intended_use: Archetype-language hypothesis generation only; not a Core Values Index result.
loss: The mapping is not derived from the proprietary CVI scoring method or item bank.
The four outputs are research analogs over Soveraeign constructs only.
Weights are hypotheses for empirical evaluation.
